title: The museum and what is in it
target: What the museum level in R.E.P.O. brings with it — its own artwork, a prop defined by the game, and a head that opens, lights up and goes red.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A run heading into the museum
A keycard if the office is locked
A crew that will not stand next to the head

steps.do: Expect the museum to be a theme with artwork of its own rather than a generic hall.
steps.because: the game ships separate level artwork per theme, with the museum among them (level museum 01)

steps.do: Treat the props in it as things the game defines rather than as scenery.
steps.because: the game defines its own museum props rather than only scenery (MuseumPropMoneyHead)

steps.do: Watch the head, because it opens and closes rather than sitting still.
steps.because: it is a head that opens and closes, with a top half, a bottom half and a mesh transform of its own, and a sound for each (headTransform, headTopTransform, headBottomTransform, headTopMeshTransform, soundOpen, soundClose)

steps.do: Expect the opening to be staged.
steps.because: opening it has an animation curve and a second curve for its lights, with open particles and a spot light (animationCurve, animationCurveLights, particlesOpen, spotLight)

steps.do: Read the eyes, because they go red with a sound and a cooldown of their own.
steps.because: its eyes have a red state with its own sound, a cooldown curve and a colour used while cooling (evilEyes, soundRedEyes, animationCurveEyesCoolDown, colorCooldown, fireEyes)

steps.do: Notice the room going quiet while the prop is active.
steps.because: it carries a low-pass filter for the walls, so the room is muffled while the prop is active (lowPassWall)

steps.do: Know that a cosmetic out in the world carries a condition of its own.
steps.because: cosmetic objects have a condition tracked in the game (CosmeticWorldObjectHealth)

steps.do: Check the office door before assuming the level is closed to you.
steps.because: the office door is a keycard door kept in a locked and an unlocked state (ShopKeycardDoor, shop office keycard_LOCKED, shop office keycard_UNLOCKED)

commonMistakes: Treating the museum's props as decoration and walking into them.
Standing beside the head while it opens.
Missing the room going quiet as a sign that the prop is active.
Assuming the office is out of reach without checking the keycard door.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
